name: Owl's Head Berry Farm
tagline: Owl's Head Berry Farm at https://www.owlsheadfarm.com
description: In 263 Blueberry Farm Road, VT, Owl's Head Berry Farm raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
